edits.old: rwb-source-data contract fake: test data that sets up ACE state is written against the rwb-source-data contract fake, not against the recovery.v_ace_* views or extension tables. The suite otherwise runs against the deployed SIT services and their published contracts, because the point of the story is that the real cross-service behaviour is proved (R5.4 class I).
edits.new: rwb-source-data contract fake: test data that sets up ACE state is written against the rwb-source-data contract fake, not against the recovery.v_ace_* views or extension tables. No rwb-case contract fake is used: the rwb-case reads are answered by the deployed SIT service through its published contract, and a fake endpoint fails the topology check before any load is generated. The contract fake library version published for these fakes is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E1002-ITG-22). The suite otherwise runs against the deployed SIT services and their published contracts, because the point of the story is that the real cross-service behaviour is proved (R5.4 class I).
